title: Say Managbulong na Balitok ed Kalawakan
intro: Imadyin mo so malaknab a kampo ed desierto diad sakey a bekta na panaalagar tan ag-inkaseguro. Sakey a baleg a lider so linma parad miting ed Dios, a tinaynan to so sakey a komunidad a manpipilalek ed sakey a bengatlan nanengneng a bembenan. Diad saman ya agmakainawa ya itunda, sakey a makapasagyat a too so onarap ya walaan na saray mankirlap a sipan tan sakey a masilib a pinalsa ya singa mabilay.
clues: Kaiba ak ed saramay tinmaynan ed Ehipto a kaiba nen Musa, ya anengneng ko so inkaapag na dayat pian makatakas kami.
Anengneng ko nen linma so lider mi ed palandey ed loob na apataplon labi pian mangawat na panangigiya.
Nantipon ak na saray dekorasyon ed saray totoo tan pinorma ko ra diad panamegley na dilin limak.
Nanggawa ak na kilaw a baka ya mangiiter na ungol, tan tinawag ko ray totoo ya onla diman.
Angala ak na sakey a dakulap na dabok ed bakat na mensahero tan inbantak ko itan ed ginawak.
Inkompronta ak nen Musa tan kinondena ya ibagan 'ag mo ak diwiten' tan manbilay ya arawi, ya walay insipan ya miting parad panangukom.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: As-Samiri
Abu Lahab
Namrud
Haman
Qarun

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Kinerew toy panagdayew bilang sankatageyan a katawan ed Ehipto
Nanggawa na biong pian makaliktar ed baleg a delap
Ingganggan toy baleg ya apoy pian napoolan si Ibrahim
Nanggawa na balitok ya kilaw a baka ya amalikdo ed saray Israelita
Implano ran pateyen si Muhammad legan ya inmalis
trial.answer: Nanggawa na balitok ya kilaw a baka ya amalikdo ed saray Israelita

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Saray tapyas na bato ya akasulat ed Torah
Sakey a dakulap a dabok manlapud dalan na mensahero
Say ambetel ya apoy ya imparaan parad si Ibrahim
Say makapanyarin trono so angitarok na sakey a kirmat
Say kiew a biong a ginawa ed saray tabla tan pako
location.answer: Sakey a dakulap a dabok manlapud dalan na mensahero

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Inakmon na dalin a kaiba iray kayamanan
Naderal lapud maksil ya sabog manlapud tawen
Nagmaliw iran unggoy lapud ag da itutumbok so Sabaton
Nalner ed dayat kaiba so manguusil ya sundalo
Nasentensiaan ya mangibaga na 'agmo ak diwiten' ya manbukbukor ya manaalagar na panangukom
outcome.answer: Nasentensiaan ya mangibaga na 'agmo ak diwiten' ya manbukbukor ya manaalagar na panangukom

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
